CustomField.formula: IF( Usage_Percentage__c >= 90 || Days_Until_Renewal__c <= 15, IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/error16.png", "Red", 16, 16), IF( Usage_Percentage__c >= 80 || Days_Until_Renewal__c <= 30, IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "Yellow", 16, 16), IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/confirm16.png", "Green", 16, 16) ) )
CustomField.label: Health Status
